parts.text:

Field agents have characterized 3 of the governing edicts, but 2 additional laws could not be recovered in full — their triggers, effects, and even which entities they involve are unknown.   E0 (sigil 0): helix=2, charge=3
  E1 (sigil 1): helix=2, charge=2
  E2 (sigil 2): helix=1, charge=6
  E3 (sigil 3): helix=0, charge=2

  [R1] Edict α: whenever helix of E1 matches helix of E0, helix and charge of E1 exchange places.
  [R2] Edict β: whenever helix of E3 exceeds 5, helix of E2 is drawn to match helix of E0.
  [R3] Edict γ: whenever helix of E0 is even, helix of E1 shifts by 1 (mod 7).

  [H0] (complete form not recovered — trigger, effect, and affected sigils are all unknown)
